snippet.title: Futurama Hit & Run the Demo - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Good news everyone! The demo has finally arrived.

Ownership of The Simpsons Hit & Run (PC) is required to play this mod, along with Lucas' Mod Launcher. 

Download Futurama Hit & Run from the Mod Bakery here: https://modbakery.donutteam.com/releases/view/48  

Download Lucas' mod Launcher here: https://modbakery.donutteam.com/releases/view/6

This is FREE to play, hope you enjoy!
